LanguageData.TtpAiTypeDescription:
Select an AI that will speak on behalf of your pawns.

None:
Effectively disables the mod.

ChatGPT:
Uses an online service called ChatGPT, created by OpenAI. Costs a small amount of money per request.

Koboldcpp:
An application you can run on your computer to generate AI responses. Requires a strong computer, e.g. 8GB VRAM, 16 or 32GB of RAM. Koboldcpp does not cost money.
LanguageData.TtpChatGptModelDescription:
gpt-3.5-turbo:
The simplest model and cheapest to run.

gpt-3.5-turbo-16k:
Similar to the gpt-3.5-turbo model but with a longer context length (16k), meaning it can keep track of longer conversations.

gpt-3.5-turbo-1106:
Smarter version of gpt-3.5-turbo, with improved instruction following, and a 16k context length meaning it can keep track of longer conversations. Can cost about $0.50 to $1 USD after a few hours of usage.

gpt-4:
The most sophisticated model of ChatGPT, with advanced reasoning skills, and an 8k context window. The most expensive to run.
LanguageData.TtpChatPromptInMemoryPrompt: Include chat prompt in memory prompt?
LanguageData.TtpChatPromptInMemoryPromptDesc: Includes the 'prompt' into the prompt for creating memories. This adds more characters to the prompt overall but might give context to the conversation.
LanguageData.TtpApiKeyDescription: API key for OpenAI service. This can be gotten from the OpenAI Playground website. Requires you to sign up with OpenAI on their playground website. This API key will link your ChatGPT usage to your account with OpenAI. API keys usually look like a long jumble of letters and numbers, paste that in here to make ChatGPT work. OpenAI blocks requests made without an API key since their service is not free.
LanguageData.TtpDefaultPromptDesc: Default prompt used for AI interactions.
LanguageData.TtpSummaryPrompt: Prompt for AI to create memories
LanguageData.TtpSummaryPromptDesc: Must instruct the AI to make a response that adheres to this format: '[number] [description]' - such as '+1 Good talk' or '-1 Insulted' or '2 Deep talk'. Not using this format or an extremely similar format will cause the memories to not form. This does have a little bit of leeway, for example the following will work: "5! I had a great chat with Bob - it was amazing!", or "-2, bad chat."
LanguageData.TtpOnlyBadHealthConditions: Only show AI bad health conditions?
LanguageData.TtpOnlyBadHealthConditionsDesc: Only tell the AI about bad health conditions. This can keep the prompt less cluttered by random harmless conditions.
LanguageData.TtpNumMemoriesDesc: How many memories will be put into the prompt if you use {recipient_memories_list} or {initiator_memories_list}. Keeping this short can make the AI less confused, keeping it long can add more context to the conversation.
LanguageData.TtpMemoryTimeBase: Base time how long memories last (days)
LanguageData.TtpMemoryTimeBaseDesc: The base time it takes for a memory to fade away (in days). Memories will always last at least this long.
LanguageData.TtpMemoryExtraTimeDesc: The extra time for memories to fade away (in days). This is based on how impactful the memory is. For example a memory like 'Insulted me: -1' will add this amount of time. -2 will give twice that amount of days.
LanguageData.TtpMaxMemories: Maximum amount of memories to track
LanguageData.TtpMaxMemoriesDescription: How many memories this mod will handle before it starts to delete the memories that were going to expire the soonest
LanguageData.TtpTemperatureDesc: Set the temperature. This controls how much 'randomness' or unpredictability to use. Higher values mean more creative. Lower values mean more deterministic.
LanguageData.TtpMaxTokensDesc: Maximum number of 'tokens' the AI may use before it's cut off. More tokens means this will allow longer responses.
LanguageData.TtpMaxTokensMemoriesDesc: Maximum number of tokens when asking the AI to form a memory. More tokens means this will allow longer responses.
LanguageData.TtpFrequencyPenaltyDesc: Frequency penalty for repetition. Higher the penalty, the less tolerant of repetition the model will be.
